title: Prior Knowledge Integration via LLM Encoding and Pseudo Event Regulation for Video Moment Retrieval

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: Prior Knowledge Integration via LLM Encoding and Pseudo Event Regulation for Video Moment Retrieval In this paper, we explore the use of large language models (LLMs) to enhance video moment retrieval (VMR) by integrating general knowledge and pseudo-events as priors.

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Additionally, we utilize pseudo-events, identified via event detection, to guide accurate moment prediction within event boundaries, reducing distractions from adjacent moments.
